summary: Alithya Group filed a Form 6-K attaching an amending agreement to its credit facility, which references the sale of multiple Datum entities (Datum Consulting Group, LLC, Datum Consulting Group Australia Pty Limited, Datum Consulting Group S.R.L., Datum Solutions DOO (Serbia), DCG Spain, S.L.U., DCG UK Limited, Datum Cybertech India Pvt Ltd., Datum Solutions DOO (Montenegro), and 9467-8778 Quebec Inc.) to Medivra Holdings LLC, effective as of March 31, 2026. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing is a credit agreement amendment to reflect the divestiture, which was previously consented to by lenders. Watch for closing conditions and potential regulatory approvals; risk-arb hinges on final consideration and any undisclosed earnouts.
